critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the fuselage geometry by duplicating the existing window row primitive along the vertical axis to create two distinct parallel rows. Set the vertical offset between these rows to 15% of the total fuselage height, and adjust the forward-most windows on the upper deck to follow a 20-degree upward curvature to align with the hump's radius.
